facts.text: Designated accessible parking for visitors who use wheelchairs or walkers is next to the office and gift shop.
facts.quote: For visitors who rely on wheelchairs and walkers, designated, accessible parking is available next to the office and gift shop.

facts.text: The site says much of the grounds are wheelchair accessible; the path to the house is compacted gravel.
facts.quote: Much of the grounds are wheelchair accessible. The path to the house is compacted gravel.

facts.text: A wheelchair ramp at the back of the house reaches the first floor only; the upstairs is not wheelchair accessible.
quote: The wheelchair ramp, at the back of the house, gives access to the interior of the house (only the first floor).
The upstairs of the Dinsmore home is not wheelchair accessible.

facts.text: The family graveyard sits on a hilltop about 0.2 miles behind the house, reached by a hiking trail that can be slick when wet.
facts.quote: The Dinsmore family graveyard is located on the top of a hill roughly .2 miles behind the house and requires an able body with a walking stick to manage. The path up to the graveyard is a hiking trail and can become slick in wet conditions.

facts.text: Visitors are asked to contact the site in advance so staff can plan accommodations, including mobile exhibits and additional artifacts.
facts.quote: So that we can make your visit as enjoyable as possible, please contact us in advance of your visit and we will make all efforts to accommodate your limitations and share as much of the Dinsmore family experience as possible through mobile exhibits and additional artifacts.

facts.text: Dinsmore describes picnic tables across the lawn and under shade trees as easily accessible. Table clearances and the surfaces of each approach are not specified.
facts.quote: There are easily accessible picnic tables located all over the lawn and under the shade trees.

facts.text: The admissions page lists house tours Friday–Sunday, 1–5 p.m., starting on the hour with the last tour at 4 p.m. Reserve through the site’s calendar. It lists closures on Easter Sunday and December 15 through April 1; check the calendar for the intended date.
quote: Tours begin on the hour, last tour at 4:00pm*: Friday 1:00pm – 5:00pm Saturday 1:00pm – 5:00pm Sunday 1:00pm – 5:00pm *Closed Easter Sunday *Closed from December 15th through April 1st.
Please visit Calendar to make a reservation.

facts.text: The admissions page lists office and gift-shop hours of 12:30–4 p.m. Friday–Sunday, ending earlier than its published house-tour visiting hours. Confirm arrival and check-in arrangements when reserving.
quote: Office and gift shop hours: Friday 12:30pm – 4:00pm Saturday 12:30pm – 4:00pm Sunday 12:30pm – 4:00pm
Tours begin on the hour, last tour at 4:00pm*: Friday 1:00pm – 5:00pm Saturday 1:00pm – 5:00pm Sunday 1:00pm – 5:00pm

facts.text: The 2026 events page describes regular house tours as lasting approximately 45 minutes to an hour and lists 859-586-6117 for more information. Ask about seating and rest breaks when arranging a visit; these are not described.
quote: Calendar of Events for 2026

Please visit us for our regular house tours, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, from 1:00 to 5:00. Tours last approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour. The cost is $10/adults & $3 children 5 and above. Please call (859)586-6117 for more information.

facts.text: The admissions page offers group tours for groups of ten or more, school groups and private tour groups. Confirm the route, first-floor arrangements and timing directly before organizing a group visit.
facts.quote: Group tours available for 10 or more people , school groups , or private tour groups .

facts.text: The Madison Avenue entrance has a sidewalk ramp and push-button doors. The passenger elevator to the right of the escalators connects the two main levels.
quote: A ramp is located from the sidewalk to the Center entrance/exit on the Madison Ave. side of the building. The Center entry doors are push button automated at this entrance/exit.
A passenger elevator is located to the right of the escalators for access between the Center’s 2 main levels.

facts.text: The venue lists accessible public restrooms, wheelchair access to meeting/event rooms and accessible Learning Center seating.
quote: There are accessible restrooms for each gender readily available in public areas.
Meeting Rooms/Ballroom/The Learning Center/Event Center – All are accessible by wheelchair.
The Learning Center 400 seat amphitheater (with accessible seating)

facts.text: Two wheelchairs may be signed out from Administrative Offices, first come, first served, with photo ID held until return. Riser ramps should be requested ahead of time.
quote: The Center has 2 wheelchairs available for use on a first come, first serve basis. These chairs are located within the Administrative Offices and must be signed out. Photo identification will also be required to be left on file until the return of the chair.
There are ramps available for riser accessibility and should be requested ahead of time to prepare for use.

facts.text: Powered wheelchairs, scooters and Segways are allowed only for people with disabilities and only if they can be operated safely. Other power-driven mobility devices must be electric or battery powered and kept to pedestrian speed.
facts.quote: The Center only allows powered wheelchairs, scooters, and Segway’s for people with disabilities as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act and if they can be operated safely in our facility. Only electric or battery powered OPDMD are allowed inside the facility. OPDMD cannot travel at a speed greater than the pedestrian traffic.

facts.text: The venue describes an elevator from the Main Lobby to the third-floor Conference Level and says its concession stands can be reached by wheelchair.
quote: Main Lobby 8,000 square feet of public space equipped for registration, exhibits and receptions Staircases, escalators, and elevator to third floor Conference Level
All concession stands at the convention center are accessible by wheelchair.

facts.text: There are two Mamava lactation pods, one on each level.
quote: Do you have a nursing room?
Yes, we have 2 mamava pods. One on each level.

facts.text: The FAQ says a walkway connects the Cincinnati Marriott at RiverCenter directly to the Conference Level. It does not describe the complete hotel-to-event route or door controls.
facts.quote: Yes, The Cincinnati Marriott at RiverCenter directly connects via walkway to the Center’s Conference Level.

facts.text: The venue warns of ongoing construction around the center. For oversized-vehicle parking, call ABM at 513-929-9200 to find out whether arrangements can be made; a space is not guaranteed.
facts.quote: Due to the on-going construction surrounding the Center, any oversized vehicle seeking parking needs to call ABM at 513-929-9200 to see if arrangements can be made.

facts.text: The venue lists Kenton County Parking Garage at 220 Madison Avenue with 44 accessible spaces. It lists 500 spaces available to the public during weekday business hours out of 1,500 total; it does not say how many of those public spaces are accessible or describe the route to the center.
facts.quote: Kenton County Parking Garage (859) 581-6888 220 Madison Ave. Covington, KY 41011 1500 spaces (44 Accessible) 500 spaces available to the public during weekday business hours

facts.text: The venue lists RiverCenter Garage at 50 E. RiverCenter Boulevard with 40 accessible spaces. It lists 150 spaces available to the public during weekday business hours out of 850 total; accessible-space availability and the route to the center need confirmation.
facts.quote: RiverCenter Garage (859) 431-7049 50 E. RiverCenter Blvd. Covington, KY 41011 850 spaces (40 Accessible) 150 spaces available to public during weekday business hours

facts.text: The venue lists Marriott Garage at 10 W. RiverCenter Boulevard with four accessible spaces and 50 spaces available to the public out of 365 total. The listing does not identify which public spaces are accessible or establish a continuous route to the center.
facts.quote: Marriott Garage (859) 431-7049 10 W. RiverCenter Blvd. Covington, KY 41011 365 spaces (4 Accessible) 50 spaces available to public

facts.text: Adjustable, flexible microphones are available for meeting rooms, the ballroom, Learning Center and Event Center. Ask the event organizer about the setup; this statement does not establish assistive-listening or captioning services.
facts.quote: Meeting Rooms/Ballroom/The Learning Center/Event Center – All are accessible by wheelchair. There are ramps available for riser accessibility and should be requested ahead of time to prepare for use. Microphones are available that can be easily adjusted and are flexible for use.

facts.text: The FAQ permits hazers and fog machines when coordinated through the event planner. Whether an individual event uses them needs confirmation with its organizer.
quote: May hazers and/or fog machines be used within the Center?
Yes, but must be coordinated through your Event Planner.

facts.text: The center is locked after each day’s contracted event hours; it does not offer round-the-clock visitor access. Confirm the event’s entry and exit arrangements.
quote: Is there 24-hour access to the Center?
For security seasons, the Center is locked and secured at the end of each days contracted hours.

facts.text: Target’s chain instructions say to scan an Order Pickup barcode at the pickup kiosk, or show it at Guest Services if a kiosk is unavailable. The barcode is in the app or Order Details. This does not confirm a kiosk or its access features at Newport.
facts.quote: Most stores will have an Order Pickup Kiosk to scan your Order Pickup barcode. Scan your Order Pickup barcode at the Order Pickup Kiosk or present to a team member at the Guest Services desk, if Kiosk is not available. You can find the barcode by opening the Target app when your order is ready for pickup, or by going to Order Details and select View barcode.

facts.text: For in-store Order Pickup without a barcode, Target’s chain instructions allow a valid, unexpired government-issued photo ID at Guest Services. Adult-beverage pickup separately requires the person collecting it to be 21 or older and present valid identification.
quote: If you aren’t using the barcode, you can present one of the following forms of ID to a team member at Guest Services. Be sure the ID is valid and has not yet expired: Government-issued photo ID
Guest must be 21+ years old and present a valid form of identification to pick up adult beverages when using Order Pickup.

facts.text: When someone else collects an order, Target’s help page distinguishes the services: Drive Up uses an invited shopping partner saved to your Target account; in-store Order Pickup also allows an alternate pickup person added at checkout. Arrange the appropriate person before collection.
quote: Currently, Drive Up orders can only be picked up by the shopping partner you’ve already invited to your Target account.

Currently, Order Pickup orders can be picked up by a shopping partner, someone you’ve invited and saved to your Target account, or an alternate pickup person, someone you’ve added to your order at checkout.

facts.text: Target generally holds pickup orders for three days. Orders containing fresh or frozen groceries are held only until the close of the next business day and cannot be extended. Other orders can be extended three more days through Order Details before the original window ends; uncollected orders are canceled and refunded.
facts.quote: Most Drive Up and Order Pickup orders are held for three days. If your order isn’t picked up within three days, we’ll cancel the order and issue a refund to your original form of payment. If your order contains fresh or frozen grocery items, your order will be held until close of the next business day before being canceled and refunded. Orders that don’t contain fresh or frozen groceries can have the pickup window extended by an additional three days on your Order details page. You must do this before the end of your initial pickup window. Orders with fresh or frozen grocery can’t be extended.

facts.text: For an eligible return, Target’s help page says Drive Up may appear when starting a return in Order Details. Eligibility varies by item and location; problems may require going inside to Guest Services. Confirm the offered return method before relying on a car-side return at Newport.
quote: Returning with Drive Up is a new service that is available at most stores for some items. If your item is eligible, you may be able to choose Drive Up as an option when you Start a return through your Order Details page. Not all items or locations will be available for a return with Drive Up.

If there are any issues with your return, you can carefully pull out of the Drive Up space and re-park in a normal parking spot. Go into the store to Guest Services, where they may be able to help troubleshoot your return issues.

facts.text: Target’s chain instructions tell Drive Up customers to look for designated parking signs close to the front of the store. This is not a Newport parking-space map or confirmation of a parking-to-door route.
quote: Where do I park for Drive Up?
Look for designated Drive Up parking signs close to the front of the store.

facts.text: Wheelchair-accessible and low-mobility seating is offered on each level; ADA tickets are sold through the FC Cincinnati Ticketing Department, and event-day ADA sales are typically limited.
facts.quote: TQL Stadium offers wheelchair accessible and low mobility seating on each level of the stadium at comparable prices and sightlines. Tickets for all ADA sections are available to purchase directly through the FC Cincinnati Ticketing Department. They can be reached prior to each event at 513-977-5425. Event-day sales of ADA tickets are available, but are typically limited.

facts.text: Stadium wheelchairs are staff-operated for transport between gates and seats on a first-come, first-served basis and cannot be kept for the event; guests are encouraged to bring their own mobility devices.
facts.quote: Guests needing wheelchair accommodations are encouraged to bring their own mobility devices to TQL Stadium. If assistance is needed, guests should notify the closest Guest Experience representative located at any entrance or visit the Guest Experience Center located behind Section E6/220 upon their arrival and request the use of a wheelchair. Wheelchairs belonging to TQL Stadium are operated by Guest Experience staff and are available for transit between gates and seating locations. Wheelchair transport service to and from entrances to a guest’s seat is available on a first-come, first-served basis and demand may cause an increase in wait time for an accommodation. We are unable to allow guests to keep wheelchairs throughout the events.

facts.text: Sensory bags with noise-canceling headphones and a quiet sensory room are available at the Guest Experience Center behind section E6; bags are checked out with a credit card or photo ID.
quote: Sensory bags are available for guests to use during each event. Each bag contains a pair of noise canceling headphones, as well as other items that stimulate the senses. These bags are located in the Guest Experience Center behind section E6. Guests may check out these bags by providing a credit card or Photo ID. Any questions regarding sensory bags should be directed to the Guest Experience Center. P&G Sensory Room Any guest who is in need of a therapeutic, quiet space to go to during events is welcome to use the Sensory room, located in the back of the Guest Experience Center behind section E6. This room features a variety of equipment that guests can use in ways to regulate their brain’s negative reactions to external stimuli

facts.text: Complimentary assistive listening devices can be checked out at the Guest Experience Center behind E6 with a credit card or photo ID. Closed captioning is on the southeast-corner auxiliary videoboard and the Stadium page of the FCC App.
facts.quote: Assistive Listening Devices are available and complimentary to guests for all stadium events. These devices are located in Guest Experience Center behind section E6. Guests may check out these devices by providing a credit card or Photo ID. Any questions regarding Assisted Listening Devices should be directed to the Guest Experience Center. Closed Captioning Closed captioning can be found on the auxiliary videoboard in the SE corner of TQL Stadium or on the FCC App in the Stadium page.

facts.text: Guests with a medical condition that prevents passing through a magnetometer are screened by an alternative method.
facts.quote: If you have a medical condition that prevents you from passing through a magnetometer, an alternative method of screening will be used.

facts.text: All stadium gates offer accessible entry lines. Ask Guest Experience staff for the route that fits your assigned seating area.
facts.quote: For the convenience of any guest with a disability, all gates at TQL Stadium are equipped with easily accessible lines to minimize wait times.

facts.text: Allegiant Gate is on the south side of the stadium off Central Avenue. Confirm your gate before traveling.
facts.quote: Allegiant Gate is on the south side of TQL Stadium off Central Avenue.

facts.text: First Financial Gate is on the east side of the stadium off Central Parkway. Use the official gate map to plan your approach.
facts.quote: First Financial Gate is on the east side of TQL Stadium off Central Parkway.

facts.text: Guests and staff with limited mobility receive priority use of passenger elevators. Ask Guest Experience staff for the appropriate elevator; some elevators periodically serve media and team staff.
facts.quote: Elevators: Priority use of passenger elevators will be given to guests and staff with limited mobility. Stairs should be used to navigate the stadium whenever possible. Some elevators are used to move the media and team staff and will be periodically taken out of service for this purpose. To ensure safe and efficient operations of the elevators, we ask our guests to follow the directions of the elevator operators, the elevator lobby attendants, and other stadium staff at all times. For assistance with finding an elevator, please locate the closest Guest Experience team member.

facts.text: FC Cincinnati identifies Town Center Garage at 1223 Central Parkway as ADA parking within its parking-pass-only garages. Confirm your parking pass and accessible-space arrangements before traveling.
quote: Note: These garages are for parking passes ONLY. There is no cash parking at these garages on matchdays.
Town Center Garage (ADA) : 1223 Central Parkway, Cincinnati, Ohio 45214

facts.text: The parking guide lists designated rideshare pickup and drop-off locations on Central Avenue, Ezzard Charles Drive and West 14th Street, plus a Liberty Street location. It also warns that Wade Street is closed for construction. Check the current matchday map and follow staff directions.
quote: Fans who have scheduled a rideshare service (Taxi, Uber, Lyft) will be dropped off/picked up at one of three locations near TQL Stadium: Ezzard Charles Drive Central Avenue West 14th Street South Side of Liberty, Eastbound between John Street and Central Avenue.
Wade Street is closed to pedestrians and vehicles due to construction.

facts.text: The Bailey's general-admission supporter tickets are for safe standing without a physical seat. If you need seated or wheelchair-accessible accommodation, confirm the appropriate ticket with FC Cincinnati before purchasing.
quote: Supporters Section: Tickets for the Supporters Section (sections 106-110) at TQL Stadium are general admission and are sold on a first-come, first-served basis. Tickets in this location will be ‘safe standing’ and will not have a physical seat.
The Bailey supporter section is an exception to this rule.

facts.text: Supporter sections prohibit yellow and opposing-team colors. Check the club's current section-specific dress rules before attending.
facts.quote: Supporter sections do not allow yellow or opposing team colors.

facts.text: In its guide for the November 7, 2026 match, FC Cincinnati describes singing, drums, flags and smoke as expected parts of the Bailey experience. Check current event guidance when planning your visit.
quote: FC Cincinnati host Nashville SC on Saturday, November 7 at TQL Stadium.
The Bailey is general admission, safe standing only. Singing, drums, flags, and smoke are expected during the match.

facts.text: The stadium guide lists four family restrooms on the concourse, intended for fans with small children or disabilities, at sections 106, 133 and E6/220. The guide calls them ADA-accessible but does not give their dimensions or adult-changing equipment.
facts.quote: Family Restrooms: Family restrooms are intended for fans with small children and fans with disabilities. There are four (4) ADA-accessible family restrooms located on the concourse level throughout the stadium. These can be found outside sections 106, 133, and E6/220. For other restroom locations, please refer to the Restrooms section.

facts.text: Baby-changing tables are listed in all public restrooms, including family restrooms, and in the Pampers Nursing Room behind E6/220. These are baby-changing facilities; adult-changing provision is not established by this statement.
facts.quote: Baby Changing Tables: For your convenience, baby changing tables are available in all public restrooms, including family restrooms, as well as the Pampers Nursing Room located in the Guest Experience Center on the concourse level behind section E6/220.

facts.text: The stadium’s clear-bag policy allows exceptions for medically necessary bags or items only after inspection and Stadium Management approval. Arrange any questions about medical supplies before arrival.
facts.quote: Exceptions for medically necessary bags or items will be made after proper inspection and Stadium Management approval.

facts.text: The stadium guide permits one factory-sealed 20-ounce water bottle and lists fountains for refilling. At events designated all-pour, the bottle must be opened and its contents poured into a cup after entry. Check the rules for the specific event.
facts.quote: Water Bottles: Fans are permitted to bring in one (1) 20-oz. factory-sealed water bottle. Water fountains are available throughout the stadium for fans to refill their bottles. Specific events that are classified as all-pour events will require that the water bottle be opened and poured inside a cup once inside the gates.

facts.text: A nursing room is inside the Guest Experience Center behind E6/220. The guide also lists nursing pods near sections 133 and 103 and outside the Guest Experience Center, plus a pod described as ADA-accessible in the First Financial Club. Confirm admission to the relevant club area and current availability.
facts.quote: Nursing: Nursing guests requesting a more private location in which to breastfeed, pump, or spend some quiet time may use the Nursing Room located inside the Guest Experience Center on the Concourse Level behind Section E6/220. This suite provides privacy, cleanliness, and all necessities including bottle warmers for nursing mothers. Pampers Nursing Pods can be found throughout the Concourse Level, specifically near Sections 133 and 103, as well as just outside the Guest Experience Center. An ADA-accessible Nursing Pod is available in the First Financial Club.

facts.text: The First Aid station is on the concourse behind section 133 and is staffed with certified emergency medical personnel during events. For immediate help, the guide directs guests to the nearest Guest Experience or Security team member.
facts.quote: First Aid: The Mercy Health First Aid station is located on the concourse level behind section 133 and will be staffed with certified emergency medical personnel at all times during an event. Additionally, first aid teams can be found throughout the concourse and can be contacted by the Guest Experience Center behind section E6/220. In the case of an emergency, please find your nearest Guest Experience or Security team member for assistance.

facts.text: The stadium publishes a no-re-entry policy during events. Plan any need to return to a vehicle or leave for a break before entering.
facts.quote: Re-Entry Policy: TQL Stadium has a no re-entry policy during events.

facts.text: On matchdays, ADA seating-relocation requests go to the Guest Experience Center at E6/220 and depend on availability. A request does not guarantee a different seat.
facts.quote: On matchdays, all ADA seating relocations can be directed to the Guest Experience Center (section E6/220) while availability lasts.

facts.text: The accessibility guide permits canes, walkers and manual or electric wheelchairs in all stadium areas. It prohibits Segways, tri-bikes and golf carts because of concourse space and safety restrictions.
facts.quote: Manually operated mobility aids (such as canes and walkers) and wheelchairs – both manually operated and electric – are permitted in all areas of the stadium. Due to space restrictions on the concourse, and for the safety of all guests at TQL Stadium, segways, tri-bikes and golf carts are not permitted inside the stadium.
